note: Plan v2 section 7.4. The checked in classification of every rule id in section 4, which `scripts/check-rules.ts` uses to decide which ones must have a fixture case. Splitting it this way, rather than guessing from the prose, means a NEW rule id added to the plan fails the check until somebody classifies it, which is the point: the failure mode this guards against is a rule quietly arriving with no case behind it.
